main_text.p: rem ita narrat Gregorius Turonensis ut Beveregii causæ non parùm noceat; ex illa, siquidem narratione liquet Canones quibus de agimus Gallicanis Episcopis hactenus incognitos fuisse, nec Canonum Codici quo utebantur insertos: Nam Gregorius de quaternione qui Apostolicos continebat Canones, tanquam de novo quaternione loquitur, & Gallicano Canonum Codici novissimè adnexo: Beveregius cautè egit, & quaternionis novitate offensus, hæc Gregorij verba quaternio novus in ista commutavit, quaternio unus; Gregorius tamen quaternionem illum novum nuncupat, & de Rege Chilperico qui eum transmiserat verba faciens, sic rem narrat. Greg. Tur. Hist. li. 5. c. 18. Ipse vero ad Metatum discessit, transmittens librum Canonum in quo erat quaternio novus adnexus, habens Canones quasi Apostolicos continentes hæc: Episcopus in homicidio, adulterio, & perjurio deprehensus à Sacerdotio divellatur. In Canonem xxvi. innuit Concilium Chalcedonense Can. 14. ad hunc Apostolicum Canonem respexisse his verbis, Quoniam in nonnullis Provinciis concessum est Lectoribus & Cantoribus uxores ducere: Sed fallitur Vir doctus, Canon siquidem Chalcedonensis nonnullas tantùm memorat Provincias in quibus Lectoribus & Cantoribus concessum erat uxores duce-re:

page.notes: The note "Greg. Tur. Hist. li. 5. c. 18." is printed in three short lines in the margin, and is shown here as one note. The paragraph is taken as one continuous paragraph: no clear indent is visible before the italic block "Ipse vero", so it may be a separate paragraph in the printed book. The last word is printed as "re:" on its own right-aligned line after "duce-", and is kept as the completion of the broken word. Printed "xxvi." is in small capitals and is copied in lower case as it appears.
